description: The built-in slash commands (docs/FEATURES.md section 12.3, rulings R67 and R72): the one table every client and the server hold. name, hint and description are what the command menu shows (the server's GET /commands answers with them). args names the grammar of what follows the name (FEATURES.md 12.4). sealed says whether it is offered in a sealed chat. admin marks a command offered only to the owner and admins: everyone else is not shown it and it is not a command for them. group is only for reading. aliases are other names a command answers to that the menu does not show. A community's saved reply, custom command or bot command of the same name hides a built-in on that server (parse.json, hidden_cases).
